headline: Week 17: Derrick Henry Runs A Train On Dynasty, Stroud Boys Bring A Spork To A Gunfight
subhead: Championship-adjacent football and somebody's QB room scored less than my grandma's bowling average.
matchOfTheWeek: Christian McCalfinjury 175.16, McBridesStrangeWhiteHock 172.60 — a 2.56-point heart attack decided by Derrick Henry casually dropping 45.6 and Trey McBride going full TE-cheat-code for 28.6 on the other side. Mattwunder finally lived up to a team name that's been a running joke for two years, and LargestOfRocks watched Malik Willis put up 31.5 like 'wait, this is the timeline that kills me?' Brutal way to lose. Beautiful way to win.
powerRankingsShakeup: Egbukkake stomping for 159 has szara looking like an actual contender instead of the guy who drafts Patriots WRs for fun. Stroud Boys posting a 78.78 in WEEK 17 — bjewett13, that's not a score, that's a SAT subsection.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the corpse. Stroud Boys, 78.78. In a playoff-adjacent week. Money Mill$ couldn't even mint a participation trophy and The Prodigal Son apparently stayed prodigal. bjewett13, you got beat by QAmon scoring 93 — KyleDech won a game where his roster looked like a Tuesday waiver wire and he's STILL going to put it on the mantle. Dead Rat energy all around, but a W is a W when you're playing the JV squad.

Over in the actual football game, mattwunder rode Derrick Henry's 45.6 and CMC's 28.1 like a man who finally remembered he drafted those guys on purpose. Christian McCalfinjury winning by 2.56 is the most on-brand thing this league has ever produced — and he STILL left Jacory Croskey-Merritt's 22.5 on the bench. You won. Barely. Because the universe owed you one. LargestOfRocks, McBride and Malik Willis combined for 60 and you LOST. Unreal pain.

Nut Olave Your Face cooked Browning Out 170-146 with Mustard going for 39.9 and Charbonnet chipping in 26. Patrickreegs, hitting 96.2% lineup efficiency and still getting smoked by 24 is the fantasy equivalent of running a perfect 40 and finishing fourth. Optimal-and-out.

Egbukkake hung 159 on Little Peckers behind QB1.02 Drake Maye (32.4) and Chase Brown (29.1). 7BigPapi7 got 27 from Rhamondre and basically nothing else — Unc is officially aging in dog years. And szara, congrats, but Tyler Shough dropped 21.9 ON YOUR BENCH. You won by 32 and STILL fumbled a top-5 stat line.

Meanwhile Tnicolle of T Swift's Baddies wasn't even playing this week and STILL managed to lose — 50.44 points benched, including Luther Burden's 27.8. That's not a lineup, that's a hostage situation. The Good Ladds let Stefon Diggs cook 22.1 from the pine, ChrisCubby's Brock Purdy went thermonuclear for 37.9 in a meaningless watch, and BigD's Jake Tonges put up 22.5 in a uniform Rub My Chubb didn't even know existed. Every team found a unique way to disappoint. Beautiful sport.
